ovesena_kasha_banan.name: Oatmeal with banana and yogurt
steps: Cook the oats in twice their volume of water for 3–5 minutes, stirring.
Let the porridge cool for 2–3 minutes.
Add the yogurt and the banana, sliced into rounds.
Sprinkle with cinnamon and serve.

ovesena_kasha_yabalka_orehi.name: Oatmeal with apple, cinnamon and walnuts
steps: Grate or finely chop the apple.
Put the oats, milk and apple in a small pot and cook over low heat for 5–6 minutes, stirring.
Add the cinnamon and stir.
Serve topped with crushed walnuts and a little honey if you like.

overnight_oats_grucki_yogurt.name: Overnight oats with Greek yogurt and honey
steps: In the evening, mix the oats, Greek yogurt, milk, honey and chia seeds in a jar or bowl.
Cover and refrigerate for at least 6 hours or overnight.
In the morning, stir and top with the berries.

izvara_med_gorski_plodove.name: Cottage cheese with honey and berries
steps: If the berries are frozen, thaw them in advance or microwave for 1 minute.
Put the cottage cheese in a bowl, add the berries and drizzle with honey.

skir_yagodi_bademi.name: Skyr with strawberries and almonds
steps: Wash and slice the strawberries.
Put the skyr in a bowl, add the strawberries and sprinkle with the chopped almonds.

mishmash.name: Mishmash (Bulgarian scrambled eggs with peppers, tomatoes and feta)
steps: Dice the onion, peppers and tomatoes.
Sauté the onion and peppers in the oil for 5–6 minutes, then add the tomatoes and cook for another 3–4 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the crumbled sirene and pour them into the pan.
Stir over low heat until the eggs are set but still moist.
Sprinkle with black pepper and chopped parsley.

yaitsa_po_panagyurski.name: Panagyurishte-style eggs (light version)
steps: Mix the yogurt with the crushed garlic and a pinch of salt and spread it on a plate.
Bring water to a boil in a wide pot, add the vinegar and lower the heat until the water is just simmering.
Crack each egg into a small bowl and gently slide it into the water. Poach for 3 minutes, until the whites are set.
Lift the eggs out with a slotted spoon and arrange them on the yogurt.
Melt the butter, add the paprika for a few seconds and pour over the eggs.

omlet_spanak_sirene.name: Spinach and feta omelette
steps: Heat the olive oil in a pan and sauté the spinach for 1–2 minutes, until wilted.
Beat the eggs with the black pepper and pour them over the spinach.
Sprinkle with the crumbled sirene and cook, covered, over low heat for 4–5 minutes.
Fold the omelette in half and serve.

tost_yaitse_avokado.name: Wholegrain toast with egg and avocado
steps: Toast the bread slices.
Mash the avocado with a fork, lemon juice, salt and black pepper.
Fry the eggs in a dry pan (or boil them for 7 minutes).
Spread the avocado on the toast, add the eggs and, if you like, tomato slices.

filiya_izvara_domat.name: Cottage cheese toast with tomato and cucumber
steps: Mix the cottage cheese with the chopped dill and a pinch of salt.
Spread the cottage cheese on the bread slices.
Serve with sliced tomato and cucumber.

proteinovi_palachinki_izvara.name: Protein pancakes with cottage cheese
steps: Blend the oats, eggs, cottage cheese, milk, baking powder and vanilla until smooth.
Wipe a pan with a little oil (using a paper towel) and heat it over medium heat.
Pour in 2–3 tablespoons of batter per pancake and cook for 1–2 minutes on each side.
Serve with berries and honey if you like.

shakshuka.name: Shakshuka
steps: Slice the onion and peppers into strips and sauté them in the olive oil for 6–7 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and stir for 30 seconds.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 8–10 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
Make wells in the sauce and crack the eggs into them. Cook, covered, for 5–6 minutes, until the whites are set.
Sprinkle with crumbled sirene and parsley and serve straight from the pan.

pileshko_oriz_brokoli.name: Chicken breast with rice and broccoli
steps: Cook the rice in salted water according to the package directions (about 15 minutes).
Cut the chicken into bite-sized pieces and season with salt, black pepper and paprika.
Fry the chicken in the olive oil over high heat for 6–8 minutes, until browned and cooked through.
Boil or steam the broccoli for 5–6 minutes.
Serve the chicken with the rice and broccoli, drizzle with lemon juice and sprinkle with finely chopped garlic.

pile_s_oriz_na_furna.name: Oven-baked chicken with rice
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Sauté the chopped onion and carrots in the oil for 5 minutes, add the rice and paprika and stir for 1–2 minutes.
Transfer the rice to a baking dish, pour in hot water (2.5 times the volume of the rice) and add salt.
Arrange the chicken pieces, seasoned with salt and black pepper, on top.
Bake for 45–50 minutes, until the rice has absorbed the water and the chicken is golden.

pecheni_pileshki_butcheta_kartofi.name: Roast chicken drumsticks with potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C.
Cut the potatoes into slices or quarters and the onion into large chunks.
Toss the potatoes, onion, drumsticks, olive oil, garlic and spices in a baking dish.
Roast for 45–50 minutes, turning once halfway, until the drumsticks are golden.

pileshko_kari_oriz.name: Chicken curry with rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Sauté the finely chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the grated ginger, garlic and curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add the bite-sized chicken pieces and cook for 5 minutes.
Add the tomatoes and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Remove from the heat and stir in the yogurt. Serve with the rice.

pileshki_suvlaki_dzadziki_bulgur.name: Chicken souvlaki with tzatziki and bulgur
steps: Cut the chicken into cubes and marinate for at least 15 minutes in half the olive oil, the lemon juice, oregano, salt and half the garlic.
Pour twice the volume of boiling salted water over the bulgur, cover and leave for 15 minutes.
For the tzatziki, grate the cucumber, squeeze out the water and mix it with the Greek yogurt, the remaining garlic and the dill.
Thread the meat onto skewers (or just pan-fry it) and cook in a grill pan for 8–10 minutes, turning.
Serve with the bulgur, tzatziki and sliced tomato and onion.

pasta_pileshko_spanak.name: Pasta with chicken and spinach
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water according to the package directions.
Fry the bite-sized chicken pieces in the olive oil for 6–7 minutes.
Add the garlic and spinach and stir until the spinach wilts.
Pour in the milk, add the grated Parmesan and black pepper and let the sauce thicken for 2–3 minutes.
Toss with the drained pasta and serve.

tortila_pile_zelenchutsi.name: Chicken and vegetable wraps
steps: Slice the chicken, peppers and onion into thin strips.
Fry them in the olive oil over high heat for 7–8 minutes with the paprika, cumin and salt.
Warm the tortillas in a dry pan for 20 seconds on each side.
Spread the tortillas with Greek yogurt, add the lettuce, tomatoes and chicken and roll them up.

pueshko_bulgur_pecheni_zelenchutsi.name: Turkey breast with bulgur and roasted vegetables
steps: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Cut the zucchini, peppers and onion into large chunks, toss with half the olive oil, oregano and salt and roast for 25 minutes.
Pour twice the volume of boiling salted water over the bulgur, cover and leave for 15 minutes.
Season the turkey with salt, black pepper and garlic and pan-fry it in the remaining olive oil for 4–5 minutes on each side.
Let the meat rest for 3 minutes, slice it and serve with the bulgur and vegetables.

svinsko_file_sladki_kartofi.name: Pork tenderloin with sweet potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Dice the sweet potatoes, toss with half the olive oil and salt and roast for 25–30 minutes.
Rub the pork tenderloin with mustard, garlic, paprika, black pepper and salt.
Sear the meat in a hot pan with the remaining olive oil for 2 minutes on each side, then transfer it to the oven for 12–15 minutes.
Boil the green beans in salted water for 5–6 minutes.
Let the meat rest for 5 minutes, slice it into medallions and serve.

svinsko_gabi_oriz.name: Pork with mushrooms and rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Slice the meat into thin strips and fry in the oil over high heat for 5 minutes. Remove from the pan.
In the same pan, sauté the onion and sliced mushrooms for 6–7 minutes, until the liquid has evaporated.
Return the meat, add the garlic, milk, salt and black pepper and cook for 5 minutes, until the sauce thickens.
Sprinkle with parsley and serve with the rice.

svinsko_stir_fry_oriz.name: Asian-style pork stir-fry with rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Slice the meat into thin strips and the vegetables into strips and small florets.
Stir-fry the meat in very hot oil for 3–4 minutes and remove it.
Stir-fry the vegetables for 4–5 minutes, stirring constantly – they should stay crisp.
Return the meat, add the garlic, grated ginger, soy sauce and honey and stir for 1 more minute. Serve with the rice.

svinski_parzholi_pecheni_zelenchutsi.name: Pork chops with roasted vegetables
steps: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Cut up the potatoes, zucchini and peppers, toss with the olive oil, oregano and half the salt and roast for 35–40 minutes.
Season the chops with garlic, paprika, black pepper and the remaining salt.
Cook the chops in a hot grill pan for 4–5 minutes on each side.
Serve with the roasted vegetables.

svinsko_sas_zele.name: Pork with sauerkraut
steps: Cut the meat into cubes and brown it in the oil in a pot or clay casserole for 5–6 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and sauté for 3–4 minutes, then add the paprika.
Add the chopped sauerkraut and black pepper and pour in half a cup of water.
Cover and bake at 180 °C (or cook over low heat on the stovetop) for about 75–90 minutes, until the meat is tender.
Salt is usually not needed – the sauerkraut is salty enough.

teleshki_stek_kartofi_salata.name: Beef steak with potatoes and salad
steps: Preheat the oven to 210 °C. Slice the potatoes, toss with half the olive oil and salt and roast for 30–35 minutes.
Take the steak out of the fridge 20 minutes before cooking and pat it dry with paper towels.
Season with salt and black pepper and cook in a very hot pan for 3–4 minutes on each side (for medium).
Let the meat rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Make a salad with the lettuce, tomatoes and cucumber, dressed with the remaining olive oil and lemon juice.

teleshko_v_gyuvech_zelenchutsi.name: Beef and vegetable gyuvech (clay-pot stew)
steps: Cut the meat into cubes and brown it in the oil over high heat for 5–6 minutes.
Add the chopped onion and carrots and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the paprika.
Transfer to a clay pot, add the potatoes, peppers, mushrooms, tomatoes, salt and black pepper and pour in 1 cup of water.
Cover and bake at 180 °C for about 1 hour 45 minutes, until the meat is tender.
Remove the lid for the last 15 minutes so the sauce thickens.

pasta_boloneze.name: Pasta Bolognese
steps: Sauté the finely chopped onion and grated carrot in the olive oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown it, breaking it up with a spoon, until it changes colour.
Add the garlic, tomatoes, oregano, salt and black pepper and let the sauce simmer over low heat for 20–25 minutes.
Cook the pasta in salted water according to the package directions.
Serve the pasta with the sauce, sprinkled with Parmesan if you like.

chili_kon_karne.name: Chili con carne
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and peppers in the oil for 5 minutes.
Add the mince and brown it until it changes colour.
Add the garlic, cumin and paprika and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, drained beans, corn and salt and cook over low heat for 20–25 minutes.
Serve on its own or with rice.

musaka.name: Moussaka (Bulgarian potato and mince bake)
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Dice the potatoes and finely chop the onion and tomatoes.
Sauté the onion in the oil for 4–5 minutes, add the mince and brown it until it changes colour. Add the tomatoes, paprika, black pepper and salt.
Mix the mince with the potatoes in a baking dish, pour in water to come halfway up and bake for 40–45 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the yogurt and pour over the moussaka.
Bake for another 12–15 minutes, until the topping is golden. Let rest for 10 minutes before cutting.

kyufteta_na_furna_kartofi.name: Oven-baked meatballs with potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Slice the potatoes, toss with the oil and half the salt and arrange them in a baking dish.
Mix the mince with the grated onion, egg, oats, parsley, cumin, black pepper and the remaining salt. Knead well and leave for 10 minutes.
Shape into patties with wet hands and arrange them on top of the potatoes.
Bake for 35–40 minutes, turning the meatballs halfway.

palneni_chushki_kayma_oriz.name: Peppers stuffed with mince and rice
steps: Cut out the pepper stems and remove the seeds.
Sauté the chopped onion in the oil, add the mince and brown it. Add the rice, grated tomato, paprika, salt and parsley and stir for 2 minutes.
Fill the peppers about 3/4 full and stand them upright in a baking dish.
Pour in hot water to halfway up the peppers, cover with foil and bake at 180 °C for about 50 minutes. Remove the foil for the last 10 minutes.
Serve with yogurt.

syomga_kartofi_brokoli.name: Salmon with potatoes and broccoli
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Dice the potatoes, toss with the olive oil and a little salt and roast for 15 minutes.
Add the broccoli and the salmon, seasoned with salt, black pepper and lemon juice, to the dish.
Roast for another 12–15 minutes, until the fish flakes easily with a fork.
Sprinkle with dill and serve with a lemon wedge.

byala_riba_na_furna_zelenchutsi.name: Baked white fish with vegetables
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Thinly slice the potatoes (if using) and roast them for 15 minutes with half the olive oil.
Cut up the zucchini, peppers, tomatoes and onion and spread them in the dish.
Place the fish fillets, seasoned with salt, garlic and lemon juice, on top and drizzle with the remaining olive oil.
Bake for 18–20 minutes. Sprinkle with parsley before serving.

skumriya_na_furna_kartofi.name: Baked mackerel with potatoes
steps: Preheat the oven to 200 °C. Slice the potatoes and cut the onion into rings, toss with the oil and half the salt and roast for 20 minutes.
Clean the mackerel, salt it inside and out, sprinkle with paprika and put a lemon slice and parsley in the cavity.
Place the fish on top of the potatoes and bake for another 18–20 minutes.
Make a salad of finely shredded cabbage with vinegar and a pinch of salt and serve alongside.

pastarva_limon_kartofi.name: Trout with lemon and potatoes
steps: Boil the potatoes in salted water for 15–20 minutes and slice them.
Salt the trout and pan-fry it in the butter for 4–5 minutes on each side.
Towards the end, add the garlic and lemon juice to the pan and spoon the sauce over the fish.
Sprinkle the potatoes with dill and serve with the fish and a green salad.

pasta_skaridi_chesan.name: Garlic shrimp pasta
steps: Cook the pasta in salted water according to the package directions. Reserve half a cup of the cooking water.
Heat the olive oil and fry the sliced garlic for 30 seconds without letting it brown.
Add the shrimp (and chopped tomatoes, if you like) and cook for 3–4 minutes, until pink.
Add the pasta, a little of the cooking water, the lemon juice and parsley and toss.

poke_riba_ton_oriz.name: Tuna, rice and vegetable bowl (poke)
steps: Cook the rice and let it cool.
Dice the cucumber and avocado and grate the carrots.
Spread the rice in a bowl and top with the tuna, vegetables and corn.
Drizzle with soy sauce and lemon juice.

salata_riba_ton_bob_tsarevitsa.name: Tuna, bean and corn salad
steps: Drain and rinse the beans and corn.
Chop the lettuce, tomatoes and onion.
Mix everything in a bowl and add the tuna in large chunks.
Dress with olive oil, lemon juice and salt.

salata_riba_ton_yaitse_kartofi.name: Tuna, egg and potato salad
steps: Boil the potatoes for 15–20 minutes and the eggs for 8 minutes. Boil the green beans for 5 minutes.
Peel and slice the potatoes and eggs.
Whisk the olive oil, mustard, vinegar and salt for the dressing.
Arrange the lettuce, potatoes, beans, tomatoes, eggs and tuna on a plate and drizzle with the dressing.

tsezar_salata_pile.name: Chicken Caesar salad
steps: Season the chicken with salt and black pepper and cook it in a grill pan with the olive oil for 5–6 minutes on each side.
Cut the bread into cubes and toast in a dry pan or in the oven until crisp.
For the dressing, mix the Greek yogurt, lemon juice, mustard, crushed garlic and half the grated Parmesan.
Chop the lettuce, toss it with the dressing and top with the sliced chicken, croutons and remaining Parmesan.

grutska_salata_pile.name: Greek salad with chicken
steps: Season the chicken with salt and oregano and cook it in a grill pan for 5–6 minutes on each side.
Cut the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper and onion into large chunks.
Arrange the vegetables in a bowl and top with the sirene in one piece and the sliced chicken.
Drizzle with olive oil and vinegar and sprinkle with oregano.

salata_kinoa_pile.name: Quinoa and chicken salad
steps: Rinse the quinoa and cook it in twice its volume of salted water for 12–15 minutes. Let it cool.
Cook the chicken in a grill pan and cut it into bite-sized pieces.
Dice the vegetables and finely chop the parsley.
Mix everything together and dress with lemon juice, olive oil and salt.

salata_syomga_avokado.name: Salmon and avocado salad
steps: Salt the salmon and bake it at 200 °C for 12–15 minutes, or pan-fry it for 4 minutes on each side.
Chop the lettuce, cucumber, tomatoes and avocado.
Arrange the salad, top with the salmon in pieces and sprinkle with the pumpkin seeds.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil.

salata_teleshko_rukola.name: Beef and rocket salad
steps: Season the meat with salt and black pepper and sear it in a very hot pan for 3 minutes on each side.
Let it rest for 5 minutes and slice it into thin strips.
Arrange the rocket and halved cherry tomatoes, then top with the meat and shaved Parmesan.
Drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar.

salata_pueshko_yabalka_orehi.name: Turkey, apple and walnut salad
steps: Salt the turkey and cook it in a grill pan for 5–6 minutes on each side. Slice it into strips.
Thinly slice the apple and drizzle with a little lemon juice.
Whisk the olive oil, mustard, remaining lemon juice and honey for the dressing.
Combine the lettuce, apple and meat, drizzle with the dressing and sprinkle with crushed walnuts.

salata_nahut_krastavitsa_domati.name: Chickpea, cucumber and tomato salad
steps: Drain and rinse the chickpeas.
Dice the cucumber, tomatoes, pepper and onion and finely chop the parsley.
Mix everything and dress with lemon juice, olive oil, cumin and salt.

krem_supa_chervena_leshta.name: Creamy red lentil soup
steps: Sauté the chopped onion and carrots in the olive oil for 5 minutes, then add the garlic, cumin and paprika.
Add the rinsed lentils and 3 times as much water (by volume) and season with salt.
Simmer for 18–20 minutes, until the lentils break down.
Blend until smooth and add the lemon juice. If it's too thick, thin with a little hot water.

kari_nahut_spanak.name: Chickpea and spinach curry
steps: Sauté the finely chopped onion in the oil for 5 minutes, add the garlic, grated ginger and curry powder and stir for 1 minute.
Add the tomatoes, drained chickpeas and salt and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the spinach and stir until wilted.
Serve on its own or with rice.

tofu_zelenchutsi_oriz.name: Tofu with vegetables and rice
steps: Cook the rice according to the package directions.
Pat the tofu dry with paper towels and cut it into cubes.
Fry the tofu in half the oil until golden on all sides and remove it.
Stir-fry the vegetables in the remaining oil for 4–5 minutes, add the garlic, ginger, soy sauce and tofu and toss. Serve with the rice.

elda_gabi_yaitse.name: Buckwheat with mushrooms and egg
steps: Rinse the buckwheat and cook it in twice its volume of salted water for 15 minutes.
Sauté the chopped onion and mushrooms in the butter for 7–8 minutes, until the liquid has evaporated.
Mix the buckwheat with the mushrooms and black pepper.
Fry or boil the eggs and serve them on top. Sprinkle with parsley.

fritata_zelenchutsi_sirene.name: Vegetable and feta frittata
steps: Preheat the oven to 190 °C.
Sauté the chopped zucchini, peppers and onion in the olive oil in an ovenproof pan for 5–6 minutes.
Beat the eggs with the salt, black pepper and parsley and pour over the vegetables. Crumble the sirene on top.
Cook on the stovetop for 2 minutes, then transfer to the oven for 12–15 minutes, until set.

shopska_salata.name: Shopska salad
steps: Dice the tomatoes, cucumber, pepper and onion.
Dress with oil, vinegar and salt and toss.
Grate the sirene over the top and sprinkle with parsley.

snezhanka.name: Snezhanka (yogurt and cucumber salad)
steps: Cut the cucumber into very small cubes, or grate it and squeeze out the water.
Mix the Greek yogurt with the cucumber, crushed garlic, dill and salt.
Serve sprinkled with crushed walnuts and a few drops of olive oil.

tarator.name: Tarator (cold cucumber and yogurt soup)
steps: Dice the cucumber into small cubes.
Whisk the yogurt with enough cold water to reach the consistency you like.
Add the cucumber, crushed garlic, dill, oil and salt.
Serve cold, sprinkled with crushed walnuts.

pileshka_supa_zastroyka.name: Chicken soup with egg-and-yogurt liaison
steps: Put the chicken in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil and skim off the foam. Simmer for 20 minutes.
Remove the meat, add the chopped carrots and onion to the broth and simmer for 10 minutes.
Add the vermicelli and salt and cook for another 5 minutes. Return the shredded meat.
For the liaison, beat the eggs with the yogurt and lemon juice, temper with a little broth and pour into the soup while stirring constantly; do not let it boil again.
Sprinkle with parsley.

humus_zelenchukovi_prachitsi.name: Hummus with vegetable sticks
steps: Blend the chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt, adding a little cold water at a time, until smooth and creamy.
Serve the hummus drizzled with olive oil, with carrots and cucumber cut into sticks.

izvara_yabalka_kanela.name: Cottage cheese with apple and cinnamon
steps: Grate or dice the apple.
Mix it with the cottage cheese, sprinkle with cinnamon and add honey if you like.

kiselo_mlyako_orehi_med.name: Yogurt with walnuts and honey
steps: Put the yogurt in a bowl, sprinkle with crushed walnuts and drizzle with honey.

yabalka_fastacheno_maslo.name: Apple with peanut butter
steps: Slice the apple and spread the slices with peanut butter or dip them in it.

orizovki_izvara_domat.name: Rice cakes with cottage cheese and tomato
steps: Spread the rice cakes with the cottage cheese.
Top with tomato slices and sprinkle with salt and black pepper.

vareni_yaitsa_krastavitsa.name: Boiled eggs with cucumber
steps: Boil the eggs for 8–9 minutes from when the water boils and cool them in cold water.
Peel and serve with sliced cucumber and a pinch of salt.

plodova_salata_kiselo_mlyako.name: Fruit salad with yogurt
steps: Cut the fruit into bite-sized pieces.
Pour the yogurt over it, drizzle with honey if you like and sprinkle with walnuts.

zelenchutsi_dip_kiselo_mlyako.name: Carrots and peppers with yogurt-dill dip
steps: Mix the Greek yogurt with the chopped dill, crushed garlic and salt.
Cut the carrots, peppers and cucumber into sticks and serve with the dip.

proteinovi_brauni.name: Protein brownies
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line a 20×20 cm pan with baking paper.
Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, banana, oats, cocoa, protein powder, sweetener, baking powder and vanilla until smooth.
Pour into the pan and sprinkle with the chopped dark chocolate.
Bake for 20–22 minutes – the centre should stay slightly moist.
Let cool completely and cut into 8 pieces.

brauni_bob_kakao.name: Black bean cocoa brownies
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C and line a 20×20 cm pan with baking paper.
Blend all the ingredients except the chocolate until completely smooth – you shouldn't be able to taste the beans.
Pour into the pan, level the top and sprinkle with the chopped chocolate.
Bake for 20–22 minutes. Let cool and cut into 8 pieces.

brauni_tikvichki.name: Zucchini brownies
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Finely grate the zucchini and squeeze out the water well.
Grind the oats into flour.
Beat the eggs with the Greek yogurt and sweetener, add the oat flour, cocoa and baking powder, then the zucchini.
Pour into a 20×20 cm pan lined with paper, sprinkle with chocolate and bake for 22–25 minutes.
Let cool and cut into 8 pieces.

cheesecake_izvara_v_chashi.name: No-bake cottage cheese cheesecake cups
steps: Toast the oats in a dry pan for 2–3 minutes and mix them with the honey – this is the base.
Blend the cottage cheese with the Greek yogurt, sweetener, vanilla and lemon juice until smooth and creamy.
Layer into glasses: base, cream and berries on top.
Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before serving.

proteinov_keks_v_chasha.name: Protein mug cake
steps: Grind the oats into flour.
In a large mug, mix the egg, milk, sweetener, oat flour, cocoa, protein powder and baking powder.
Press a piece of chocolate into the centre.
Microwave on full power for 70–90 seconds.

bananovi_biskvitki_ovesni.name: Banana oat cookies
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Mash the bananas with a fork and mix with the oats, peanut butter, cinnamon and chopped chocolate.
Spoon cookies onto baking paper (about 3 per serving).
Bake for 13–15 minutes, until golden at the edges.

morkoven_keks_ovesen.name: Carrot oat cake
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C. Finely grate the carrots.
Grind the oats into flour and mix with the cinnamon and baking powder.
Beat the eggs with the Greek yogurt, sweetener and vanilla, then add the dry ingredients, carrots and chopped walnuts.
Pour into a lined loaf tin and bake for 30–35 minutes (until a skewer comes out clean).
If you like, spread the cooled cake with cottage cheese whipped with a little sweetener. Cut into 8 pieces.

pecheni_yabalki_orehi_kanela.name: Baked apples with walnuts and cinnamon
steps: Preheat the oven to 180 °C.
Core the apples without cutting all the way through.
Fill them with crushed walnuts, honey and cinnamon and arrange in a baking dish with a little water in the bottom.
Bake for 25–30 minutes, until soft. Serve warm, with Greek yogurt if you like.

chia_puding_gorski_plodove.name: Chia pudding with berries
steps: Mix the chia seeds with the milk, vanilla and honey (optional) and stir well.
After 10 minutes, stir again so no lumps form.
Refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight.
Serve topped with the berries.

sladoled_banan_kakao.name: Frozen banana and cocoa "ice cream"
steps: Slice the bananas into rounds and freeze for at least 4 hours.
Blend the frozen banana with the cocoa, milk and peanut butter in a powerful blender until it has the texture of ice cream.
Serve immediately, or freeze for another 30 minutes for a firmer ice cream.

zamrazen_yogurt_gorski_plodove.name: Frozen yogurt bark with berries
steps: Mix the Greek yogurt with the honey.
Spread it in a thin layer (about 1 cm) on a tray lined with baking paper.
Sprinkle with berries and grated dark chocolate.
Freeze for at least 3 hours and break into pieces. Keep in the freezer.

yagodi_cheren_shokolad.name: Dark chocolate strawberries
steps: Wash the strawberries and dry them well.
Melt the chocolate over a water bath or in the microwave in short 20-second bursts.
Dip the strawberries halfway into the chocolate and place them on baking paper.
Refrigerate for 15 minutes, until the chocolate sets.
